description: Replacement of the existing metal framed windows with PVCu framed double glazed windows, replacement of the existing metal doors with powder coated aluminium doors and replacement of metal frame curtain wall glazing with powder coated aluminium curtain wall glazed system to the building
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (18031-PE-100, 18031-PP-200, 18031-PP-201 received 07 December 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - When removing the debris from the site all recyclable materials (metal, glass, timber resulting from the removal of the existing windows) will be excluded from the landfill waste stream and sent to appropriate materials recycling facilities to be reused or recycled for new purposes.  Any non-recyclable materials shall be treated in a manner that conforms to current guidance such as the Site Waste Management Plan Advice Note 2018 or such other guidance as may supersede it
